name: w60_bc_v
_comment: Beam cap V, exact count by subtraction (kits/w60_beamcap.mjs, pilot pilots/w60_bc_v.json): `w` selects wëap 343 BC Hidden Volley (60 copies, one simultaneous volley of 60 blue beams from BeamPos 360 px ahead, off the play area); two Ctrl taps; then Space held 10 s fires the green spray (wëap 336): the spokes that still fit are 64 - 60 = 4 if the cap is 64 and the volley is 60; then a 3 s Left turn shows the hidden beams in the corners.
